title: Maximum Subarray Product
statement:
Find the largest product over all non-empty contiguous slices of an array.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and has at least one element; values may be any `int`, including zero and negatives.
- A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the largest product of any subarray.
- The product of every subarray is guaranteed to fit in a `long`, which is also the return type. Do not mutate `numbers`.

Examples
- `maxSubarrayProduct(new int[]{1, -2, 3, -4})` returns `24`.
- `maxSubarrayProduct(new int[]{-3, 0, -2})` returns `0`.
- `maxSubarrayProduct(new int[]{-6})` returns `-6`.
hints: A very negative product can become the largest after multiplying by another negative number.
Keep both the largest and the smallest product of a subarray ending at the current index.
Update both from the new element and the previous pair, letting a zero restart the run. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space, where n is the array length.
inputSyntax: Input: the array values (at least one), for example: [1, -2, 3, -4]
